crisis.title: You don't have to carry this alone
crisis.body: What you wrote sounds really heavy, and we're glad you said it. This isn't something the cards should answer. Right now it can help to talk with a person: the lines here are free and confidential, and the people on them are there for exactly this. You can tell them as much or as little as you want.
crisis.not_saved: We don't keep what you wrote.
crisis.contacts_intro: You can talk to someone here:
crisis.fallback_contacts: If your country isn't listed, findahelpline.com shows free, confidential lines near you.
crisis.emergency_line: If you're in danger right now, or think you might hurt yourself soon, call your local emergency number.
crisis.closing: When you feel ready, the cards will still be here.

line_purpose.crisis: If you're thinking about suicide or hurting yourself
line_purpose.violence: If someone is hurting or threatening you
line_purpose.emergency: If a life is in danger right now
line_purpose.directory: Free, confidential lines in your country

soft_lines.redirect_topic: The cards don't predict this kind of thing. Here is what they can say about you and your next step.
soft_lines.redirect_person: The cards can't tell what another person thinks or feels. Here is what they can say about you and your side of this.

provider_disclosure: To write your reading, your question is sent to our AI provider, Anthropic. Please leave out names and personal details.
reader_unavailable: The reader is unavailable right now, so here are your cards' meanings from our card base. You can try again in a moment.
followup_unavailable: The reader can't answer this question right now. It wasn't counted, so you can ask it again in a moment.
